title: Navitas Semiconductor Corp 8-K Filing — 2026-04-13
summary: Navitas Semiconductor Corporation filed an 8-K on April 13, 2026 reporting that its Board of Directors expanded from eight to ten members and appointed Gregory M. Fischer as a Class III director effective April 7, 2026. Fischer was also appointed to the Compensation Committee and Executive Steering Committee. He will receive standard non-employee director compensation including an annual retainer of $45,000 and a grant of 22,048 restricted stock units.
key_points: Board expanded from 8 to 10 members on April 7, 2026
Gregory M. Fischer appointed as Class III director, effective immediately
Fischer appointed to Compensation Committee and Executive Steering Committee
Additional retainers: $7,500 for Compensation Committee, $7,500 for Executive Steering Committee
Initial RSU grant: 22,048 units vesting prior to 2027 annual stockholders meeting
